title: Iowa Code Chapter 425 - Homestead Tax Credits, Exemptions, and Reimbursement
deposited: Iowa Code ch. 425, whole chapter. Subchapter I: the homestead tax credit and exemptions, including the disabled veteran credit (425.15). Subchapter II: the property tax credit or rent reimbursement for elderly and disabled people. Household "income" starts from Iowa net income under 422.7 and adds payments under the federal Social Security Act and other items (425.17). The claim schedules by household income are at 425.23. 41 sections.
